_description: Frigate NVR: adds the capabilities its s6 init needs, passes through the iGPU and USB Coral, sizes /dev/shm, and pre-fills the health check.
_comment: EDIT the two volume paths below to your host layout, then `uxc start frigate`. Everything else is meant to work as-is. See profiles/README.md and docs/frigate.md.
_comment_caps: ADDED on top of the --caps set (never replacing it). Frigate's s6-overlay init chowns /dev/shm/logs and remounts things: with anything less than the full permissive set PLUS these two it dies during startup with 'Operation not permitted'. CAP_SYS_ADMIN = s6 mount work, CAP_PERFMON = hardware-accelerated detectors.
_comment_mounts: Device pass-through is done in _registry.devices below - that also grants the cgroup device rule, which a bind mount alone does not. The only thing left here is /tmp: Frigate caches models and clips there and the default tmpfs is unbounded (it is RAM).
_comment_registry: The uxcd side of the container (/etc/uxc/<name>.json). Only keys you do NOT already have are written, so an upgrade or a re-pull never overwrites your edits.

_registry._comment_env: EDIT BOTH. TZ is what makes recordings and the timeline carry your local time, and FRIGATE_RTSP_PASSWORD is what config.yml's {FRIGATE_RTSP_PASSWORD} expands to - the image ships a placeholder, so change it. Editable in LuCI: Configure -> Environment.
_registry._comment_shm: Frigate sizes /dev/shm by camera count and resolution and REFUSES to start when it is too small - it logs the exact figure it wants. 1280m suits a handful of HD cameras; raise it if the log asks you to. This is RAM.
_registry._comment_devices: Missing devices are skipped, so this list is safe on a box with no GPU and no Coral. /dev/dri = VAAPI/QSV, /dev/bus/usb = USB Coral (pass the whole bus: the TPU re-enumerates after its firmware upload), /dev/apex_0 = M.2 or PCIe Coral.
_registry._comment_volumes: EDIT THESE. /config holds config.yml + the database, /media the recordings - point that one at your biggest partition.
_registry._comment_health: Lets uxcd verify an upgrade before keeping it: a bad version is rolled back automatically. Frigate needs a couple of minutes to come up with several cameras, hence the long start_period.
_registry._comment_web: Port 5000 is the web UI (auto-detected from EXPOSE too). 8554/RTSP and 8555/WebRTC are not web UIs and stay out. The scheme is stated explicitly: Frigate serves plain http, and a browser sitting on an https LuCI page will otherwise try to upgrade the link.
_registry.notes: Config lives in /config/config.yml. Frigate logs the /dev/shm size it wants at startup - set it as shm_size. Coral TPUs are passed through as whole device directories, so a re-enumerating USB TPU keeps working.
